title: Corgi Labs vs Forter
summary: Compare Corgi Labs and Forter. Corgi Labs builds a model on your own payments and runs it alongside Forter, so you see the lift before you switch.
body_markdown:
THE SHORT ANSWER


## Three differences that matter


Forter learns from a network of 2B+ identities. Corgi Labs is built around one merchant: you.


-


### A model built on your data


Forter learns from a network of 2B+ identities. Corgi Labs trains a model on your own transaction history.


-


### Proof before you switch


Corgi Labs runs alongside Forter on your payments and reports the lift against a real holdout period.


-


### Pricing tied to results


Forter is quoted per merchant, with an optional chargeback guarantee. Corgi Labs pricing is a share of the revenue lift it adds.


AT A GLANCE


## Corgi Labs and Forter compared


What each one learns from, how results are proven, and how pricing works.


### Forter


-


Learns from a network of 2B+ identities


-


Optional chargeback guarantee


-


Reports 46% fewer false declines on average


-


Custom pricing, quoted per merchant


-


90-day performance guarantee


### Corgi Labs


-


A model trained on **your own transactions**


-


**Custom** to your business and customers


-


**Proven on your history** before it goes live


-


**Pricing tied to the lift** , no fixed platform fee


-


**Free diagnostic** on read-only access


Source: Forter details from[forter.com](https://www.forter.com/) and[forter.com/pricing-offer](https://www.forter.com/pricing-offer/) , checked 27 Oct 2026.

HOW SWITCHING WORKS


## Run Corgi Labs alongside Forter


Keep Forter live while Corgi Labs proves the lift on your own payments. Switch when the numbers say so.


1.


01


### Connect


Connect your payment processor and history.


2.


02


### Backtest


We train a model on your history and show what it would have caught.


3.


03


### Run alongside


Corgi Labs scores the same payments as Forter without touching live traffic.


4.


04


### Switch


Once the lift is proven, Corgi Labs takes over live approve and block decisions.


5.


05


### Improve


The model keeps learning from your newest payments.


WHEN FORTER IS ENOUGH


## When Forter is the better fit


Corgi Labs isn’t the right call for every merchant.


-


### Low payment volume


A custom model needs enough of your own payment history to learn from.


-


### You want a chargeback guarantee


Forter offers one at a premium. Corgi Labs prices on the lift it adds instead.


-


### Fraud is under control


If your fraud and decline rates are where you want them, Forter may be all you need.
